Cutting Boards · In Stock

Shoreline

End-Grain Butcher Block

$145

Our flagship board. The Shoreline is built end-grain, which means the cutting surface is made of hundreds of wood fibers standing on end — they part for the knife and close back up, so the surface stays smooth and your edges stay sharp for years. Alternating black walnut and hard maple give it a quiet checkerboard the cooks in our life never stop touching.

A routed juice groove rings the surface to catch carving drippings, and four recessed rubber feet keep it planted while you work. Finished with our food-safe blend of mineral oil and beeswax.

Wood Black Walnut & Hard Maple
Construction End-grain, hand-glued
Dimensions 12 × 16 × 1¾ inches
Weight ~6.5 lbs
Finish Food-safe mineral oil & beeswax
Lead time 2–3 weeks · ships UPS Ground
Inquire About This Piece Care Guide
A note on care Hand-wash only, towel dry, and re-oil once a month (or whenever the wood looks thirsty). Never let it soak or ride the dishwasher — end-grain drinks water and will check if it gets soaked. Full routine on our Care page.
